english: Finishing a <link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> Combatant restores 100 HP, begins Health Regeneration, and grants 25% Damage Resistance (Resist x2) for 11 seconds.

source.text:
Upon finishing an Elite+ Combatant:

Restores 100 HP.
Begins Health Regeneration.
25% Damage Resist (Resist x2) for 11 seconds.
